Ferrari 458 Italia model by vicent091036, distributed with the Three.js car example. Car materials adapted for this experience.

Rendering: Three.js (MIT). Geometry decoding: Google Draco (Apache 2.0). Original fictional circuit, environment, interface, and driving code created with Astra.

An independent interactive demo. Not affiliated with Ferrari. Driving behavior is a simplified game model, not a vehicle simulation.
